evidence.title: File:Roscosmos cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev holds a cake celebrating the recent arrival of three new crewmates (iss074e0814783).jpg
evidence.description: iss074e0814783 (July 18, 2026) --- Roscosmos cosmonaut and Expedition 74 flight engineer Andrey Fedyaev poses for a portrait while holding a cake celebrating the recent arrival of three new crewmates aboard the International Space Station. Expedition 74 flight engineers Anna Kikina and Pyotr Dubrov, both from Roscosmos, and Anil Menon of NASA launched aboard the Soyuz MS-29 spacecraft from the Baikonur Cosmodrome on July 14, 2026. The trio docked to the orbital outpost's Rassvet module the same day, beginning an eight-and-a-half-month space research mission. Credit: NASA/Chris Williams
